display_long_description:
Room Raider is a high-energy mixed reality experience developed by ShemarooVerse Digital Limited, a subsidiary of India’s leading media and entertainment powerhouse, Shemaroo Entertainment. Designed for Meta Quest, this game turns your open room into a dynamic playground where entertainment meets physical fitness.
Start with engaging target practice:
- 🎯 Hit spawning square boxes with precision throws.
- 🥫 Knock down stacked cans in pyramid formations.
- ⭕ Launch balls through glowing circles that appear in your space.
- 🦆 Test your reflexes with rotating glowing ducks—hit only the right ones to score big!
Once you’ve mastered the challenges, the real battle begins. Tiny, playful creatures with spatial awareness spawn in your room, hiding behind furniture and teasing you with surprise attacks. Stay agile—jump, dodge, and move to avoid being hit, then grab balls and strike back to win!
Room Raider is more than just a game—it’s a fun, engaging workout that blends entertainment with fitness. Perfect for players of all ages, it transforms your everyday environment into an immersive arena where skill, speed, and strategy collide.
